overview.description: The Texas Precious Metals Trust Y'all Street Physical Silver ETF (YSAG) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the LBMA Silver Price index. The fund tracks the silver spot price, less expenses, using physical silver bars held in a vault located in the US. YSAG was launched on Jul 15, 2026 and is issued by Yall Street.
